messages:
alexp: Heads up — Nordex just flagged an AWB on hold in Shanghai, affects our eu-west reserved pool for this week. AWB: 123-4567890, PO: PO-7882. Need options: refile invoice, split shipment, or loaner RMA.

akiko_nordex: Sorry about that. Customs flagged HS code mismatch (we used 8473, regulator expects 8471.80). We can reclassify and refile same day if you send updated commercial invoice, otherwise refile will take 4–6 business days. Split to 2 AWBs + brokerage is also possible.

lia_ops: If it's +4–6 days, eu-west capacity hits a ~30% shortfall by Tue. Can we temporary-swap in available H200s or loaner H100s from your EU pool? We need ETA and cost uplift.

akiko_nordex: We have 10 loaner H100s in FRA depot. Air re-route to FRA ETA ~48h but needs customs bond + downpayment. Broker fee estimate: $1,200/AWB. Split shipments add ~18% extra freight & handling.

chandra: Procurement — can you pre-approve emergency commit for loaners and bond? Estimate total uplift for 10 units: air uplift ~$28k + broker ~$2.4k + customs bond hold. Approve?

chandra: Also confirm: if we accept H200 swap, perf delta is ~+15–30ms tail latency and quantization may be required for some models. Cost delta per token is lower though. Which services are impacted?

alexp: Impacted routes: chat/generate on eu-west-1 (prod), two internal stress tests tomorrow. We can degrade non-critical traffic to quantized variants, but SLA-sensitive customers will notice. Prefer loaners for production.

deploy-bot: Alert: reserved-capacity-alert eu-west-1 — H100 pool projected to drop to 60% in 18h if no inbound.

akiko_nordex: If you send the corrected commercial invoice now (change HS to 8471.80, match item description to our template) we can push a same-day clearance request. I'll attach the invoice template in thread.

alexp: Uploading invoice now. Finance, please standby to approve bond payment. Lia, can you confirm routing policy change to allow eu requests to quantized fallback for next 72h if loaners delayed?

lia_ops: Will do. I'll flip fallback at 0900 UTC and schedule rollback when loaners land. Need list of endpoints to exempt (SLA-critical).

chandra: Exempt endpoints: /v1/generate (enterprise prod), /v1/chat/stream (enterprise prod). Everything else can use fallback. Approving emergency commit for loaners and bond up to $35k.

akiko_nordex: Received invoice update. Filing reclassification now. If customs accepts, we still need to sign bond docs — ETA for clearance + release to FRA is ~12–24h after filing.

alexp: Good. Please confirm AWB update and provide new tracking when available. Also request consolidated invoice for us to expense broker & bond later (one consolidated billing preferred).

akiko_nordex: Will provide consolidated invoice and separate RMA loaner agreement. Quick manifest snippet we filed:
```
AWB: 123-4567890 | SKU: H100-80GB | QTY: 20 | HS: 8471.80 | PO: PO-7882
AWB: 123-4567891 | SKU: H100-80GB | QTY: 10 | HS: 8471.80 | PO: PO-7882-SPLIT
```

lia_ops: Noted. Action items: (1) finance to approve bond (chandra) — done; (2) vendor to send consolidated invoice + loaner contract (akiko) — awaiting; (3) ops to enable quantized fallback and exempt endpoints — lia to execute at 0900 UTC.

alexp: One more ask: if loaners don't clear, we may need to divert some eu traffic to dedicated nodes in apo-south or cn-north as short-term mitigation. Chandra — are we comfortable with cross-region routing cost hits?

chandra: Cross-region routing will increase egress + latency; estimate extra cost ~$0.12/token for enterprise routes for 48h, so plan only as last resort. Keep me posted.

akiko_nordex: Clearance request accepted by customs intake. I'll update with new AWB and ETA once outbound to FRA. Expect tracking by EOD. Sorry again for the churn. :pray:
